- INV-00113 (Rohan Pillai): 1,800,000 paise

Let me think about whether this makes sense from a reconciliation perspective. Both explanations sum to the same amount, but use different invoice combinations. The alternative uses invoices from different customers (Meera Bhat instead of Arjun Verma), though it does include Rohan Pillai and Meera Patel.

While semantically the notes don't perfectly match, from a pure reconciliation standpoint, this is a mathematically valid alternative that matches the payment amount exactly. This would represent a different "lump_sum" pattern explanation using different underlying invoices.
